entities.name: Dhu'l Nun Ayyoub
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dhu'l-Nun Ayyub was an Iraqi novelist, journalist, art critic, and editor. Known for his short stories, he was considered one of the pioneers of Iraqi literature at his time and was widely read in Iraq.
